The best chain is QB11-QB12-QB7, with QB12 in the middle. I took the IRB CZ fidelities from the default garnet calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. All 28 CZ loci on garnet have IRB data. QB12-QB11 has fidelity 0.998693 and QB12-QB7 has fidelity 0.998016. Their product is about 0.996712. The next best chain is QB16-QB11-QB12, with a product of about 0.994687.

I submitted the circuit to garnet:mock as native IQM JSON, so it uses those exact physical qubits and no transpiler step. The circuit applies prx(pi/2, pi/2) to all 3 qubits, then CZ(QB12,QB11) and CZ(QB12,QB7), then prx(pi/2, -pi/2) on QB11 and QB7. It then measures QB11, QB12 and QB7. The job ran 200 shots and completed. The counts, in the order QB11 QB12 QB7, are 000: 57, 011: 44, 100: 43 and 111: 56. The mock backend returns random results, so the counts do not show real GHZ correlations. The API reported 1.0 billed seconds for the mock job, and the helper estimated 0 credits.
